info.name: Bond Pet Foods Content API (WordPress REST API) Wp/v2 API

description.content:
The WordPress REST API (wp/v2) served from www.bondpets.com: posts, pages, media, categories, tags, comments, taxonomies, site search and the site's WooCommerce product post type. Collection reads are public; writes and most edit-context reads (users, settings) require authentication and return HTTP 401 anonymously. Derived from the site's own WordPress REST discovery index and per-route OPTIONS schemas.

Contact Support:
 Name: Bond Pet Foods
